source_note: Re0微积分2：自然底数e及其快速计算
english_source_note: Re0 Calculus 2: The Number e and Fast Computation
callout_id: Re0微积分2:自然底数e及其快速计算#7
statement_en: For $N\geq 2$, the following identity always holds: $$1+\frac{1}{1!}+\cdots+\frac{1}{N!}+\frac{1}{NN!}=3-\frac{1}{1\cdot 2\cdot 2!}-\cdots \frac{1}{(N-1)NN!}$$
callout_body: 下面的等式对于$N\geq 2$恒成立：$$1+\frac{1}{1!}+\cdots+\frac{1}{N!}+\frac{1}{NN!}=3-\frac{1}{1\cdot 2\cdot 2!}-\cdots \frac{1}{(N-1)NN!}$$
